objective: Preallocate foreign-key parent data keys from table and row-id lengths.

tasks.title: Preallocate foreign-key parent data keys
tasks.result: Foreign-key parent existence checks now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>:<row_id> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in single-column primary-key FK parent checks and composite primary-key parent row checks.
Generated key bytes, transaction get lookups, missing-parent errors, parent-reference blocking, and FK semantics are unchanged.
